name: 07081 · Springfield, NJ
findings: ZIP 07081 (Springfield) has 115 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07081 (Springfield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07081 (Springfield) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 57 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
